Subject: Supplier billing preference survey + sample invoice row format

Hi Laura —

Quick follow-up from supplier onboarding: we're finalizing the preferred invoice intake options for Redwood and want to make the onboarding as frictionless as possible for Fenwick. Two quick asks:

1) Channel preference: do you prefer submitting invoices via our vendor portal (recommended for faster PO matching and automated OCR) or by email to ap@redwood-payments.com? If email, please confirm whether your AP team can add the PO number in the subject line (e.g., "PO 12345 - INV 789").

2) Template/rows: attached is a small sample CSV (sample_invoice_rows_v2.csv) with the schema we prefer for automated ingestion (one invoice per file, line-level description, quantity/unit price, tax/VAT row if applicable, remittance address). Can you confirm your system can export this format, and whether you need any fields removed/added (VAT ID, GL code, service period)?

I've CC'd our vendor onboarding lead (Mina) and procurement (Karthik) so we can capture any policy exceptions up front. Also attaching our short supplier onboarding form (supplier_onboarding_form.pdf) — if you can return that filled, AP will kick off PO stamping.

If it's easier, we're happy to do a 20-minute screen-share to walk through the portal and the CSV mapping. Proposed times tomorrow 10:00–11:00 PT or 15:00–15:30 PT.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Vendor Programs Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear note and sample. A few things from our side:

- Channel: Our team prefers SFTP or email to ap@fenwick-ap.com today. We can start using your vendor portal, but it will require a brief internal change (we need the portal URL and an SSO invite). For an immediate go-live, email with PO in the subject is easiest.

Thanks Laura, and appreciate the quick turnaround and the filled form. Two quick clarifications from Redwood onboarding:

- PO requirement: We prefer the PO number in the subject line for email intake ("PO 12345 - INV 789"). A PDF copy of the PO attached to the invoice is optional but helps exception handling — not required for automated ingestion.
- VAT: we can accept a header-level "VAT ID" field and a line-level tax column. We'll map VAT to tax_code in our ingestion. Please leave the VAT amount as a separate numeric column (not embedded in line total).
- Portal invites: Soojin — I can send the SSO portal invite once Laura confirms the preferred portal user for Fenwick (name and email).

If email is the immediate path, we'll set two acceptance checks: subject PO match and company remittance address match. Anything that fails will route to our AP queue for manual review.

Mina
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference

Folks — quick procurement note on PO stamping and exceptions:

- Standard: For services under $50k we allow email submission with PO in subject. For >$50k we require portal onboarding + PO attached.
- SFTP: We can accommodate SFTP drops but that requires a separate connector and SLA; prefer portal for long-term automated flow.
- GL code mapping: If Fenwick can provide a 'Charge Type' column we can map to our GL automatically. Otherwise finance will need to triage on the first three invoices to create a mapping.

Marissa — can you confirm the current exception SLA for invoices that fail automated ingestion (how long before AP reaches out for remediation)?

Karthik
